products.name: Prone Leg Curl
products.short: Plate Loaded Legs & Glutes — prone leg curl for legs training on commercial floors.
description: The AFZOX CB Series Prone Leg Curl is a plate loaded machine built around a knee flexion path that isolates the hamstrings. The movement path is fixed by the frame, so the hamstrings take the load without the stabilising demand of a free-weight equivalent.
It is specified for commercial floors, where a station is in use through every peak hour rather than occasionally, and where changeover between members has to take seconds.
Catalogue photography for this range carries Life Fitness branding. AFZOX supplies and installs the equipment; manufacturer and supply terms are confirmed at quotation.
features: Independent movement arms for iso-lateral loading
Wide bolt-down base with levelling feet
